posts.role: 테크 전문 매체 The Information 공식
posts.text:
Up to 13 GW of planned Texas data center projects could be at risk following the midterms, according to a Jefferies estimate.

Powerlines founder @charlesxhua:

"When you think Ohio, when you think Texas, when you think Georgia... those are three of the fastest growing markets for data center development, for electricity demand growth."

"I think that you could make an argument that the industry at a macro sense is facing some serious pressure."

"Jefferies had announced that in Texas, up to 13GW of data center projects might be at risk under a Governor Hinojosa scenario."

"That's not just one project. That is an entire industry that has to deal with these potential headwinds coming in."
